subject.title: Control UI: Memory panel for MEMORY.md and USER.md

question: Should editable MEMORY.md/USER.md/daily-note management be a first-party Control UI memory panel, part of a broader secured workspace-file manager, or deferred until plugin Control UI contribution slots can own memory/context panels?
rationale: Current code partially covers raw root-file editing, but the missing daily-note and memory-specific UX crosses product, security, and session-state ownership boundaries that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Keep product/security review open
options.body: Use this issue to settle the core versus workspace manager versus plugin-slot owner boundary before implementation.

options.title: Fold into workspace file management
options.body: Make the broader workspace-file API/UI the canonical implementation and close this only after it lands with memory-note coverage.

options.title: Defer to plugin contribution slots
options.body: Use this issue as a memory/context-panel use case for the Control UI contribution-slot RFC instead of adding a bespoke core panel now.

recommendation.title: Keep product/security review open
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle the core versus workspace manager versus plugin-slot owner boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest inspected history across the Agents files UI and agents.files safety boundary that would constrain this decision.
